summary: Plan-only ACCEPT. Corrected ID-I08/S07/T07 and navigation-tool contract define the actual trusted Web callable, inputs, result/status, function ordering, disposal and cancellation. Vulgata.Web references Core, Infrastructure and Agents; VulgataWebComposition.ConfigureServices can register the scoped composer for a controlled SelfContained test without starting host, database or JDT. Exact source/JDT approval and root equality, purpose and Repository ID are checked before issuance; the trusted caller must supply the source grant from which it issued the opaque 18.1 context. Every navigation failure retains the three independently authorized 18.1 file functions and no navigation functions. The composition borrows read context, owns navigation context then lease, and keeps production runtime closed until T023. The correction does not widen Worker arguments, change 18.1 contracts or 18.3 shared ownership/direct-child exception. Ordered prior plan verdicts 01-12 and definition verdicts 01-08 remain resolved. Architecture classification and planned-change trigger remain. Outstanding canonical O-NFR01 wording, durable CodeGraph store, restricted real JDT and prepared Repository remain dependencies. Read-only cross-artifact and deterministic plan-content validation found no errors. Stale tasks were excluded. This verdict is not authorization.
